symptoms: high latency slow queries database timeout
root_cause: Missing index on users.email column after migration
fix: CREATE INDEX idx_users_email ON users(email)

symptoms: connection pool exhausted timeout all connections used
root_cause: Database connections leaked in background job — missing finally block
fix: Added finally block to background job connection handler

symptoms: memory usage climbing OOM process killed restart loop
root_cause: In-memory cache growing unbounded — no TTL set
fix: Set cache TTL to 300s and max size to 10000 entries

symptoms: high error rate 502 bad gateway upstream timeout
root_cause: Upstream service deployed broken TLS certificate
fix: Rolled back upstream deployment, renewed certificate

symptoms: slow queries full table scan orders table
root_cause: deploy removed index on orders.status during schema migration
fix: Re-added index CREATE INDEX idx_orders_status ON orders(status)

symptoms: connection pool leak connections not released growing
root_cause: Context manager removed from session middleware in refactor
fix: Restored context manager pattern in database session middleware

symptoms: memory leak request objects accumulating logging
root_cause: Debug logging middleware storing full request bodies in module-level list
fix: Removed request body accumulation from logging middleware

symptoms: high cpu load nginx worker oom killer
root_cause: Regex catastrophic backtracking in input validation
fix: Replaced with linear-time regex or non-regex validation

symptoms: database slow checkpoint wal file growing
root_cause: WAL mode checkpoint not running due to misconfigured auto-checkpoint threshold
fix: Set PRAGMA wal_autocheckpoint=1000 and ran PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)

symptoms: api timeout downstream service 503 retry storm
root_cause: Missing circuit breaker caused retry storm on downstream failure
fix: Implemented circuit breaker with 30s open window

symptoms: disk io high 100% iops saturation latency spike
root_cause: Log rotation not configured — single log file reached 50GB
fix: Configured logrotate with daily rotation and 7-day retention

symptoms: slow queries missing index n+1 query problem
root_cause: ORM lazy loading generating N+1 queries on user list endpoint
fix: Added eager loading with joinedload() for related models

symptoms: connection refused redis unavailable eviction
root_cause: Redis maxmemory reached and evicted active session keys
fix: Increased Redis maxmemory-policy to volatile-lru, added alerts

symptoms: high memory python gc pause objects not freed
root_cause: Circular reference between objects preventing garbage collection
fix: Used weakref.WeakValueDictionary for cache to allow GC

symptoms: deploy rollback slow queries performance regression
root_cause: New feature added missing composite index
fix: Added composite index on (tenant_id, created_at) columns

symptoms: connection timeout postgresql max_connections hit
root_cause: pgBouncer pool size increased without increasing PostgreSQL max_connections
fix: Increased max_connections to 500 and pg_hba reload

symptoms: api errors 500 null pointer exception uncaught
root_cause: deploy removed null check in user profile handler
fix: Reverted commit, added null guard with safe default value

symptoms: memory growing heap dump large string objects
root_cause: Response caching caching unbounded large payloads
fix: Added max payload size limit of 1MB to response cache

symptoms: database deadlock concurrent updates same row lock wait
root_cause: Two background jobs updating same resource without consistent lock ordering
fix: Sorted lock acquisition order alphabetically by resource ID

symptoms: cpu spike background job runaway loop
root_cause: Job scheduler retry backoff not implemented — tight loop on failure
fix: Added exponential backoff with jitter and max retries=5

symptoms: payment provider timeout 504 gateway retry storm
root_cause: Upstream payment provider outage with un-jittered retry storm
fix: Enabled circuit breaker and exponential backoff on payment gateway client

symptoms: connection timeout dynamic config flag pool acquisition
root_cause: Dynamic config sync altered db_pool_timeout_ms to 50ms
fix: Reverted dynamic configuration flag db_pool_timeout_ms to 5000ms

symptoms: intermittent network tcp rst dns failure conflicting symptoms
root_cause: Transient multi-AZ transit gateway packet drops and edge DNS flakiness
fix: Escalated to network infra on-call specialist for packet capture analysis
